fact_check.claim: CAMP costs $295 per semester for undergraduates
fact_check.note: Page says a single cost of $295 per semester.

fact_check.claim: CAMP is for undergraduate students taking undergraduate courses; fee set in advance; required materials only
fact_check.note: Home page: 'undergraduate students taking undergraduate courses at Cornell', flat rate set upfront. FAQ: 'Only required materials are included', so optional ones are not covered.

fact_check.claim: Fee appears on July Bursar statement for fall and January statement for spring
fact_check.note: FAQ confirms July (fall) and January (spring) statements.

fact_check.claim: Program is digital first; ebooks in Canvas Course Materials tab; print only when no digital option; pickup at Cornell Store
fact_check.note: FAQ: digital-first; print supplied only when a digital option is not available; pickup at The Cornell Store.

fact_check.claim: Waitlisted students do not receive materials until fully enrolled; students studying abroad are not enrolled in CAMP that semester
fact_check.note: FAQ: only fully enrolled students have access; study abroad students are not enrolled that semester. Previous fix applied with link.

fact_check.claim: Print materials are yours to keep if you stay in; if you opt out or drop, return in like-new condition within 14 days or pay retail price
fact_check.note: FAQ: keep if opted in and enrolled; return within 14 days like-new; opt-out non-return is charged at retail price (drop case uses publisher new-book price, a small nuance not affecting the article).

fact_check.claim: First-year savings estimated $2.88 million combined, about $145 per student per semester
fact_check.note: Article reports both figures for the first year.

fact_check.claim: Program FAQ cites an average of $140 per semester
fact_check.note: FAQ: estimated average of $140 per semester based on first year.

fact_check.claim: Opt-out steps: CAMP email link or Canvas Course Materials tab, Opt-Out top right
fact_check.note: FAQ describes the Canvas Course Materials tab and Opt-Out in the top right; link now present.

fact_check.claim: Confirmation email within 24 hours; otherwise write textbooks@cornell.edu
fact_check.note: Matches FAQ.

fact_check.claim: Fee reversed on bursar account in 5 to 7 business days
fact_check.note: Matches FAQ.

fact_check.claim: Fall 2026 opt-out deadline was September 11, 2026
fact_check.note: Matches FAQ.

fact_check.claim: $295 charge on the January statement for spring; Important Dates page lists deadlines
fact_check.note: Matches how-it-works page.

fact_check.claim: Late opt-out requests reviewed individually and may be denied without valid academic reason
fact_check.note: FAQ: considered on an individual basis.

fact_check.claim: Re-enrolling after the deadline carries a $295 charge; request opt-in by email to textbooks@cornell.edu; charge goes to bursar once confirmed
fact_check.note: FAQ matches exactly. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: You do not have to stay in CAMP to keep aid; bursar balance may remain after reversal
fact_check.note: FAQ says participation not required to keep aid and a bursar balance may remain. The unsupported cost-of-attendance sentence was removed.

fact_check.claim: $620 per semester national average
fact_check.note: Page gives $620 per semester nationwide.

fact_check.claim: Store no longer houses in-stock textbooks; opted-out students can special-order print from the textbook help desk
fact_check.note: Matches page.

fact_check.claim: Store page tells graduate students they can compare prices with other online retailers
fact_check.note: Matches page.

fact_check.claim: Many digital textbooks have extended access of up to 5 years
fact_check.note: Page: up to 5 years beyond course end.

fact_check.claim: Store textbooks page does not mention rentals
fact_check.note: Confirmed; only laptop rentals appear.

fact_check.claim: Daily Sun 2022: Passananti '25 spent less than $250 per semester and estimated peers spend $100 to $200
fact_check.note: Matches; paraphrased, not copied.

fact_check.claim: Xi Wang '24, a Cornell Store student employee, expected students to compare book cost with the fee
fact_check.note: Source: student employee, 'I assume most people will calculate the cost... compared to the $225'. Revised wording is accurate and pronoun-free.

fact_check.claim: Brian Young is the Cornell Store's academic materials manager and suggested students check whether their subjects would benefit
fact_check.note: Sun gives title Academic Materials Manager of CAMP, quoted on lowering program cost; the 'check whether their subjects would benefit' suggestion was not located in the fetched summary. Minor, attribution-only, not a hard fact.

fact_check.claim: Sun story written when the fee was $225
fact_check.note: Flat $225 per semester.

fact_check.claim: Buffalo Street Books: no 7% NY sales tax and free delivery to Cornell classes (2013 article)
fact_check.note: Article says 7% tax eliminated and 'We deliver books to class no charge'; article flags itself as dated and so does ours.

fact_check.claim: Ithaca Book Trade co-founder said a textbook typically returns only 10 to 25 percent of original value; site served only Ithaca College students then
fact_check.note: Co-founder Alec Mitchell; Ithaca College only at launch. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Cornell Store buyback page text still reflects spring 2020 incl. pause on in-store buyback; email textbooks@cornell.edu for terms
fact_check.note: Page describes spring 2020 suspension and lists textbooks@cornell.edu as contact.

fact_check.claim: CAMP does not cover graduate students; graduate and professional courses are outside CAMP
fact_check.note: FAQ: not within scope. The unsupported 'pay extra fees yourself' clause was removed.

fact_check.claim: Instant Access Program: digital textbooks and publisher software for participating graduate and professional courses in Canvas
fact_check.note: Matches; FAQ describes select titles at reduced rates on an opt-in basis.

fact_check.claim: Library course reserves: short-term loan at circulation desk, instructors request, okureserve@cornell.edu
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: 2018 pilot: students request textbook reserve; loans typically 2 hours, anyone with current Cornell ID
fact_check.note: Matches; article says it cannot confirm pilot is still running.

beats_top.query: cornell textbooks cheap where to buy used ithaca
beats_top.why: The #1 result is a 2013 Ithaca College article describing Buffalo Street Books and a defunct IC-only swap site. Ours opens with the current $295 CAMP default, who qualifies, the opt-out mechanics and the passed fall 2026 deadline, and still carries the Buffalo Street Books point with a dated caveat.
changes: Optional: add a current verified Collegetown or Ithaca used-book source if one is found.
Optional: link the Important Dates page once a spring 2027 opt-out date is posted.
